prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1092; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, so please just refer to me as the claimant.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving on a multi-lane road in Katy, Texas, heading toward the freeway. Traffic was moderate and I was in the right lane.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was changing lanes to the left to get around a slow truck. I checked my mirror, saw nothing there, and started to move over.

Q: What happened next?

A: A silver sedan was in my blind spot. It was on my left and it sideswiped the rear quarter panel of my car. There was a loud scrape and my car jerked toward the shoulder.

Q: Did the other driver stop?

A: Yes, they pulled onto the shoulder a little ahead of me. We exchanged information and they seemed apologetic.

Q: Were you injured at the scene?

A: Not obviously. I felt fine at first, just shaken. But within a day or two my neck got stiff and the pain started radiating into my shoulders and upper back. I also get headaches now.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: Yes, I saw my primary care doctor and I've started physical therapy. The doctor diagnosed whiplash and told me to rest and take it easy with my neck.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I've had trouble sleeping and I'm missing some time from work because of the pain. I'm willing to provide the medical records.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you in writing.

A: Okay, thank you.
